subject: literacy
concept: Understanding simple cause-and-effect relationships within a story
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student matches a 'because' card to the correct cause-effect pair from a story
exercise.pictorial: Student draws an arrow connecting a pictured cause to its pictured effect from a story
exercise.abstract: Student answers 'why did this happen' questions about a written passage

misconception_flags: picks an unrelated event as the cause

interest_binding: story content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
